six_player_gate: Require both fixed-buffer and Kuhn gates for the same candidate method. No automatic promotion or paid compute.
limitations: Frozen replay scores measure in-sample fitting, not poker generalization or optimal regret.
The three replay/initialization pairs do not isolate replay-seed and optimizer-seed effects.
Stratification changes the finite network projection objective; conditional averaging preserves each identical-input weighted target.
Kuhn uses complete information-set features and two players. Its success cannot establish six-player convergence or validate the 51-feature poker abstraction.
